method: Sachs white-line racing-plane fit inside±3.5 m from actual midpoint. Extended LGL DGM025 samples to±24 m fit an integrated cubic-smoothstep slope fade outside the marked9 m road; then independent measured positive/negative outer slopes. Source-fit residuals are separately retained in elevation/lgl-bank-fit.json.
edge_formula: Inside h: a*lane. Outside u=abs(lane)-h, v=min(u,f), t=v/f; z=edge+d0*v+(d1-d0)*f*(t^3-.5*t^4)+d1*max(0,u-f). dz/dlane eases continuously from the road bank to the measured outer slope. f=0 selects the exact previous q/plane formula.
corridor_contract: Descriptor-active stations use explicit measured shoulder-baseline controls; legacy constant runoff maxima select material without padding the physical corridor. One exported wall list drives native contact/protection and rendered barriers.
uncertainty: DGM±.15 m vertical; white-line edge±.5 m each. Bank coefficient fit and outer fade are an original continuous reconstruction, not a published exact angle. Maximum all-lane model residual.201 m is additional reconstruction error. Data-era2022 ground vs2018 orthophoto/modern reference remains qualified.
